description: This file defines the OrderStatus class within the Opencart admin controller namespace. It manages order status listings, creation, editing, deletion, and rendering views related to order statuses in the Opencart e-commerce platform's admin panel.

classes.name: OrderStatus
classes.description: Controller class for managing order status entities in the Opencart admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the main order status list page with breadcrumbs, titles, and view components.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the AJAX request for listing order statuses, outputs the list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML for the order status list, including pagination and data retrieval.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing an order status, loading necessary data and components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the form submission for adding or updating an order status, with validation and permission checks.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles deletion of selected order statuses, including permission and dependency checks.
